dedupe_keys.name: texas municipal solid waste facility data files active closed and revoked authorisations

description: These data files list the permits and other authorisations for municipal solid waste landfills and processing facilities in Texas. They are published by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality, which regulates these sites, and are refreshed every Friday. The main spreadsheet covers issued or acknowledged authorisations and pending applications for facilities that are active, inactive or not yet built; companion files cover closed facilities, revoked, withdrawn or denied authorisations and unauthorised sites. Fields include facility name and type, permit, registration or notification number, authorisation status, physical status and location, documented in guide GI-613. The page also offers lists of active landfills (GI-611) and medical waste facilities (GI-612), a map viewer of active landfills, annual reports on municipal solid waste, and the closed landfill inventory. Coverage is statewide at facility level. Files are free to download as Excel; no licence is stated. Caveats: status codes need the field guide, locations may be approximate, and capacity figures are in the annual reports, not these files. Simulation uses: facility locations, types and status for waste network, transfer and disaster debris models in Texas. Related records: the TCEQ closed MSW landfill inventory (data-tceq-closed-msw-landfill-inventory) covers historic sites, and the Arkansas permitted facility data (data-arkansas-deq-permitted-solid-waste-facilities) is a neighbouring equivalent.
